outputs.median: Median of relative intensity in voiced speech (dB)
outputs.mean: Mean of relative intensity in voiced speech (dB)
outputs.std: Standard deviation of relative intensity in voiced speech (dB)
outputs.kurt: Kurtosis of relative intensity in voiced speech (-)
outputs.voiced_fraction: Share of voiced frames in the analysed signal (0–1)

envelope.description: Intensity envelope: praat (Kaiser window 3.2/min_pitch, step timestep) or moving_average (running mean over window_duration per sample, version 1.0)

min_pitch.description: Lowest F0 for the Praat envelope; the window is 3.2/min_pitch s (Hz)

window_duration.description: Window length of the moving_average envelope (s)

frames.description: Frames the statistics are computed from: voiced (by SWIPE) or all (version 1.0)

timestep.description: Frame step of the tracker and of the Praat envelope (s)

strength_threshold.description: Minimum SWIPE pitch strength below which a frame is unvoiced

drop_bounds.description: Treat frames where SWIPE hit f_min or f_max as unvoiced

min_voiced_seconds.description: Minimum total of voiced frames (s); below it nothing is reported and the reason goes to notes
